mapper.select: select member_seq, login_id, nickname, gender, trunc(months_between(sysdate, birth_date) / 12) as age from member where login_id = #{loginId}
select count(*) from member_profile mp join member m on mp.member_seq = m.member_seq where m.login_id = #{loginId}
